name: The Stanford Natural Language Inference (SNLI) Corpus
description: The Stanford Natural Language Inference (SNLI) corpus is a collection of 570,152 human-written English sentence pairs manually labeled for balanced classification with the labels entailment, contradiction, and neutral. Created by the Stanford NLP Group, SNLI serves as a foundational benchmark for natural language inference (NLI) and evaluating sentence representations. Premise sentences are derived from Flickr30k image captions, and hypotheses were generated by Amazon Mechanical Turk crowdworkers.
